tools_desc: Command the hidden features of Windows and protect your PC.
tools_restore_desc: Before making critical changes or removing unwanted apps, always take a backup of your current healthy Windows state.
tools_restore_help_q: 💡 How do I restore to a saved point if needed?
tools_restore_help_a:
To quickly return to the restore point you created, open the Start menu, type "Recovery" and press Enter.

Click the "Open System Restore" button in the Control Panel tab that opens. In the list that appears, you will see the backup named "Ü Toolbox Checkpoint" that you just created. Just select it and press Next. Your computer will restart and return to its exact healthy state at the time.
tools_tweaks_desc: Access advanced configurations like appearance, telemetry, mouse settings, and tools to completely remove embedded programs like Edge and OneDrive.
clean_modal_desc: Select the data locations you want to clean:
ram_desc: This process safely flushes unnecessary memory used by background or suspended apps (Working Set) at the system level. It clears out RAM without causing the app to crash or slow down.
ram_res_desc: Unnecessary memory load successfully flushed. Your PC will run more stably.
shut_desc: Set a specific time or countdown timer for your computer to turn off automatically.
shut_act_d: Your computer will be automatically turned off after the specified time.
sub_tw_p: System Tools and Tweaks / Windows Customizer
tw_desc: You can easily toggle Windows 11 hidden settings, telemetry configurations, and interface options with a single click from this view.
tw_ult_d: Provides maximum hardware speed by entirely disabling processor sleep states. Use with caution if already active or on a laptop.
tw_hib_d: Destroys the hiberfil.sys file on your C: drive and frees up massive SSD space equal to your RAM capacity. Disables deep sleep state.
tw_tel_d: Disables background tracking diagnostic services that send your usage statistics to Microsoft servers.
tw_loc_d: Prevents Windows 11 from sharing your location coordinates with apps in the background.
tw_act_d: Stops tracking the timeline of your files, apps, and websites navigation data on your local device.
tw_ctx_d: Bypasses the "Show more options" slowdown in Windows 11 and returns to the large classic context menu (Might require a reboot).
tw_bing_d: Blocks unnecessary Bing(Web) results scraped from the internet when searching in the Start menu and restricts search natively. (Substantial speedup)
tw_hid_d: Automatically makes hidden files and known file extensions (.exe, .txt, etc.) visible in the File Explorer globally.
tw_deb_d: These operations permanently eradicate unbreakable system software integrated into Windows. Use ONLY if you have created a Restore Point!
about_content:
This application is a comprehensive toolkit designed to enhance your Windows 11 experience, boost your privacy, and maximize system performance.

Developer: OB Teknoloji & Community

tw_ndu_d: Stops Windows' active network tracking service per application. Disabling this resolves one of the notorious Non-Paged Pool RAM leaks and stabilizes memory. (Note: Network data in Task Manager will drop to 0. Toggling requires a system restart to take effect.)
tools_desktop_layout_desc: Save the current coordinates of your desktop icons and restore them in seconds if they ever get scrambled.
tools_folder_compressor_desc: Compress large game and program folders without performance loss using Windows' built-in algorithms, saving GBs of space.
updater_up_to_date: Current version is up to date ({version})
updater_up_to_date_toast: Your app is up to date!
updater_ready_toast: New version downloaded! Click the button to install.
tw_nagle_d: Prevents Windows from delaying network packets. Increases instant response time and lowers ping in competitive games.
tw_network_throttle_d: Removes the network restriction applied while playing media in the background, unlocking 100% of the network for games and downloads.
tw_sys_resp_d: Cancels Windows' allocation of 20% CPU for background tasks. Gives 100% CPU focus to the active game/application.
tw_gamedvr_d: Disables background screen recording services, fixing micro-stutters and input lag in games.
tw_verbose_d: Instantly displays background processes on screen during system startup or shutdown. Makes troubleshooting easier.
tw_disable_lock_d: Removes the swiping lock screen, which is unnecessary for desktop computers. Directly shows the password entry screen when PC turns on.
